sections.heading: Genoa Port Container Throughput Doubles in H1 2026

content.text: The Port of Genoa reported a 100% year-over-year increase in container throughput for H1 2026, driven by the early completion of the Sech terminal expansion and new carrier agreements with Asian shipping lines.
Port Authority data shows 1.4M TEU handled in H1 2026 versus 700K in H1 2025, with a full-year target of 2.8M TEU that would place Genoa among the top five Mediterranean ports by cargo volume.
Over €600M has been invested since 2023 in berth crane automation, expanded internal rail sidings, and digitized customs processing, cutting average vessel dwell time from 36 to 19 hours.

items: Vessel dwell time reduced from 36h to 19h

content.text: Dockworker unions note that volume growth has not translated proportionally into new hiring, and environmental groups have flagged air-quality impacts from increased maritime traffic in the gulf.

The City of Genoa has convened a roundtable with the Port Authority, unions, and trade associations next week to negotiate a phased hiring plan and mitigation measures; Livorno and Trieste are reportedly evaluating the same model.

items: Genoa gulf air quality under scrutiny
